cases.product: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
cases.quoted_other_article_only: Packaged drinking water (other than mineral water)
cases.reason_not_approved: Dispensed vending water is not automatically legally classified as packaged drinking water.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Operator process description, outlet vs sealed pack, original water source, point-of-sale label and sampling point.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed decision whether dispensed-vending product is packaged drinking water, an IS 10500 product or another current legal article; keep 0.01 mg/L packaged-water row as comparison only.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Water-matrix lead method with LOQ, outlet sampling and chain-of-custody; not automatically a general food digestion method.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Coffee-chicory mixtures are not the same article as unblended coffee.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Signed coffee and chicory percentage, roasted-ground/instant formulation and lot label; identify whether a coffee-only OTA entry governs a blended as-sold food.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Ochratoxin A article identifies coffee, not expressly coffee-chicory mixture; do not automatically apply coffee-only µg/kg.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Validate ochratoxin A extraction, recovery, LOQ and chromatographic method for actual roasted/instant coffee-chicory matrix.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.quoted_other_article_only: Infant milk substitutes and Infant foods
cases.reason_not_approved: A formulated supplement for children is not automatically infant food.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Final label, intended child age, directions/reconstitution, age eligibility, product formulation, registration category.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed classification under current special nutrition rules and exact current lead article on as-sold/reconstituted basis.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead (not chromium) method with accredited child-supplement matrix, LOQ, and actual lot basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: The CTR sets pesticide MRLs by individual pesticide and specified food. A generic 'fruits' entry for a named pesticide does not automatically settle every frozen fruit mix or product.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Species/fruit crop or mixture, frozen whole/IQF/process state, exact named pesticide and analyte residue definition.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: FSSAI pesticide MRLs are indexed by named compound and commodity; neither 'residues' nor unspecified frozen fruit gives a single MRL.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Use accredited named-residue GC-MS/MS or LC-MS/MS with fruit-specific extraction and defensible frozen/process factor.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Edible catechu is an identified product listing, but it is not itself identical to betelnut or a catechu-containing pan masala. Lead's generic fallback cannot be selected before deciding whether a specific article applies.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Acacia catechu botanical heartwood extract specification, extraction method, as-sold moisture and supplier grade.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Generic chemicals or foods-not-specified metal rows require a signed applicability decision; edible catechu extract is not automatically either.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Validate lead method for tannin-rich plant extract and matrix recovery, LOQ and sample dry/wet basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.quoted_other_article_only: Pulp and pulp products of any fruit
cases.reason_not_approved: Seedless tamarind identity and processed form must first be proven; fruit pulp is not a direct synonym.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Supplier product specification and photos proving seedless flesh, milled pulp, puree or concentrate, moisture and additions.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed copper article for the exactly marketed seedless tamarind and fruit-processing state.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Copper method verified against actual tamarind acid/moisture matrix and LOQ; published approximate 09.001 capability is not achieved LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Coconut milk powder is plant derived; the dairy milks row cannot be silently extended.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Complete manufacturer BOM showing coconut fat, added sodium caseinate/dairy proteins if any, spray-dried form and fat percentage.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed product classification and lead article for marketed coconut milk powder, not blanket dairy milk concentration factor.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Quantify fat: 09.001 scope excludes ≥40% fat foods and milk powder; validate separate lead extraction/digestion and matrix scope.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.quoted_number_NOT_APPLICABLE: 5 mg/kg on dry fat-free substance basis
cases.reason_not_approved: Cocoa beans are not cocoa powder; different process and dry-fat-free basis.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Whole fermented bean vs nib/roasted form, harvest origin, moisture/fat, sample homogenization SOP.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Written lead legal article for cocoa beans, independent of powdered cocoa dry-fat-free limit.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Representative whole-bean grinding/homogenization, lead digestion scope, fat threshold and test-result basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
cases.quoted_number_NOT_APPLICABLE: 5 mg/kg on dry fat-free substance basis
cases.reason_not_approved: Cocoa–sugar dry mixtures differ from pure cocoa powder; mixed composition and basis need signed interpretation.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: As-sold cocoa solids, sugar, fat, moisture, particle structure, pack presentation and ingredient BOM.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Specific lead article and basis for dry mixtures of cocoa and sugars; no dilution/ratio or cocoa-powder rule transfer without authority.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Matrix validation for sugar and cocoa fat ratio, homogeneity, digestion, spike recovery, LOQ and correct dry/fat-free conversions.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
cases.quoted_number_NOT_APPLICABLE: 5 mg/kg on dry fat-free substance basis
cases.reason_not_approved: Cocoa mass/liquor and cake differ from powder; fat and processing basis require a separate legal opinion.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Actual cocoa mass/liquor vs press cake, batch fat percentage, processing state and moisture.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed lead article and test reporting basis for the actual liquor or cake; prohibit powder-row auto-application.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Check 09.001 ≥40% fat exclusion for liquor; laboratory-approved higher-fat matrix preparation, LOQ and recovery required.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: A FoSCoS product identity entry for chia seeds does not establish that it is cereal grain, pulse, nut, oilseed or other named legal lead article. No exact lead comparator signed.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Salvia hispanica botanical seed authentication, whole versus milled/processed form and actual lot declaration.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR 'cereal grains' row cannot automatically include mint-family chia merely due to FSSR chapter placement.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead method across oily chia-seed homogenate, fat-related exclusion, recovery and laboratory scope.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Official FPSFA identifies carob powder from roasted carob pods. Carob is not cocoa; cocoa powder's lead expression on dry fat-free basis cannot transfer.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Ceratonia siliqua roasted pod powder versus blended cocoa, component percentage, roast and milling specs.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR cocoa-powder lead row on dry fat-free basis cannot automatically apply to ground roasted carob pods.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead assay on carob powder with validated dry matter/fat reporting and digest recovery.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Arrowroot is a root-derived material; named potato/cassava/food grain pesticides do not automatically apply to purified arrowroot flour or starch. MRL scope is pesticide- and commodity-specific.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Maranta/Curcuma rhizome species, purified starch vs whole root, harvest origin and specific residue.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR commodity-pesticide MRL must be separately determined for processed arrowroot starch, not automatically for cereals or tubers.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Named pesticide LC/GC-MS/MS scope for dried purified starch and a justified processing concentration factor.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Original FPSFA amendment history identifies a standard for water chestnut flour (Singhare ka atta). Product identity standard is not itself a lead maximum; cereal flour or canned chestnut entry cannot be borrowed.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Trapa botanical nut flour identity, drying and grind form, additives/cereal adulterants and actual lot.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: A flour called 'atta' is not for that reason a CTR 'cereal grain'. The correct lead article remains unsigned.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead method on dried water-chestnut flour including homogenisation, accredited scope and LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Animal casings have an FPSFA product-standard history. Their material (cleaned natural casing, prepared casing or artificial analogue) is not necessarily meat, edible offal or gelatin for CTR lead limits.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Slaughter species, intestine/oesophagus/bladder source, dry-salted/wet-brined process, salt loading and as-sold weight basis.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Lead limits for animal meat or rendered meat fat are not automatically transferable to digestive-membrane casings.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Validated lead sample preparation for wet salted or dried casing, salt blank, recoveries and reporting basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: At least one pesticide row expressly mentions eggs on a shell-free basis; that is not a blanket MRL for all pesticides or a solved dry egg-powder limit. Dehydration may change result basis.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Hen egg whole/yolk/white powder fraction, dehydration factor, species and named pesticide/residue definition.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Egg-shell-free fresh-egg pesticide entries do not themselves establish an MRL for dry whole/yolk/white powder as sold.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Individual pesticide analysis in dry egg fraction with fat interference, validated recovery, uncertainty and adjusted basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Pickled eggs are processed eggs in brine; an 'Eggs' MRL for a named pesticide does not alone settle matrix basis (egg vs brine vs whole pack) or concentration and composite ingredients.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Hen vs quail eggs, peeled hard-boiled state, egg-to-brine mass ratio, brine/oil/acid concentration and named pesticide.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: A shell-free egg pesticide MRL cannot be applied to egg-plus-brine without named analyte and legal matrix interpretation.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Validated pesticide extraction from drained egg / whole pack as defined by law, with matrix-specific LOQ and processing basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.quoted_other_article_only: Solid glucose and starch conversion products with sulphated ash content exceeding 1.0 per cent
cases.reason_not_approved: Dried glucose syrup cannot be assumed to meet the exact ash threshold and material identity.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Supplier dried-glucose-syrup standard, solid content, actual sulphated ash, DE, grade and laboratory CoA.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR lead high-ash starch conversion comparator requires sulphated ash >1.0%; FSSR dried glucose syrup specifies <=1.0%, so the high-ash row cannot be assumed for a conforming product.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead procedure specific to low-ash dried glucose syrup, matrix recovery, lot ash determination and method LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Edible lactose is a purified milk-derived sugar, but that does not make it liquid milk, secondary milk product, refined white sugar or dextrose monohydrate under CTR 2.1.1.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Purified lactose chemical form, whey source, >=99% dry-basis purity, actual sulphated ash and sold lot form.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Dairy-origin purified lactose is not automatically liquid milk or dehydrated milk for lead CTR limit.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Trace lead in purified crystalline lactose: contamination control, acid digestion, method specificity, LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Misri is not automatically standardized refined sugar; actual manufacturing form and identity remain unverified.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Crystal type/production route, refined sugar proof, total ash vs sulphated ash, test material representation.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed finding whether the particular misri lot is refined sugar for chromium law; no assumption from appearance.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: 09.006 targets Cr/Se/Mo in infant/nutrition products; obtain chromium-specific validated method for sugar crystals and LOQ below signed limit.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
cases.reason_not_approved: One individually named polyol does not set a universal nickel limit for the entire polyols class.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Exact INS/CAS/isomer and supplier grade for each polyol; composition and percentage of blends.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Nickel legal article for each actual compound or properly classified blend; no sorbitol rule transfer to xylitol, erythritol or mixed polyols.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: 09.006 uses nickel as an internal standard rather than measuring nickel; separate nickel assay and matrix scope required.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Salt substitutes are not necessarily food-grade salt; composition and alternate constituent limits matter.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Complete permitted potassium/other salts and additives BOM, sodium-content result, labeling and actual salt-substitute identity.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Food-grade sodium chloride salt and iron-fortified common salt metal comparators are not automatically low-sodium salt substitute mixtures.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead in KCl-rich matrix with salt interference and validated digestion/ICP accuracy and LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Trehalose is a distinct disaccharide, and merely being sweet does not prove it falls under CTR refined sugar, glucose, or high-ash sugar provisions. Actual substance identity and standard needed.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Named trehalose INS/CAS and commercial ingredient grade, purity, ash type and actual regulatory product/usage class.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Trehalose quality total ash is not interchangeable with sulphated ash >1% high-ash sugar CTR criterion.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Low-concentration lead in purified trehalose matrix, method blank and recovery/LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: The commercial name Sajji Khar alone does not prove chemical identity or allow substitution of sodium hydroxide, salt or other specific chemical lead limits.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Exact Sajji Khar mineral chemicals/CAS, manufacturing route, applicant/license/supplier identity and September register exact outcome.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: June 2026 closed/withdrawn NSF applications do not establish every Sajji Khar approved, prohibited or covered by a particular CTR lead row; September 2026 applicant entries still unverified.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead assay for actual carbonate/alkali mixture and accredited high-alkali/salt matrix; first resolve lawful product identity.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.reason_not_approved: Appendix A lists permitted additives/uses, not one universal lead specification for the entire open FoSCoS additive category. Distinct substances have distinct rows and purity requirements.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Each named additive INS/CAS, function and food-category, supplier grade, individual food-grade impurity monograph and current operative permission.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Broad Appendix A additive class is not a single 'chemicals not otherwise specified' article or uniform lead maximum.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Ingredient-specific lead impurity assay, compatible digestion and reference purity-method source; no class-wide generic PASS.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.reason_not_approved: The grouped FoSCoS Schedule VA–VF listing is not a specific chemical article. One selected preservative/colour/stabiliser lead row cannot be applied to all nutraceutical additives.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Exact VA–VF original schedule row, named additive, substance CAS/grade and current 2022/2024/2026 effective legal crosswalk.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Historic nutraceutical additive schedule class is not proof each constituent currently approved or has one lead CTR limit.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Method of lead assessment tied to named additive grade, sample and source-specific purity specification.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.reason_not_approved: A generic enzyme preparation can include active enzymes, carriers and processing aids. CTR chemical and Indian Pharmacopoeia provisos are specific and do not grant one lead limit to all enzymes.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Named enzyme EC ID, production/donor organisms, processing aid vs additive role, carriers, commercial residual/impurity grade and permission.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: The 2022 Processing Aid Appendix C table for certain enzymes is not a blanket lead approval for unnamed preparations.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Enzyme-preparation matrix lead analysis with carrier/protein/salt interference, validated recovery and LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.reason_not_approved: CTR has separate total-aflatoxin and B1 entries with distinct named foods and 'food product containing any of above' wording. A grouped nutraceutical ingredient schedule is not itself one of those proven commodities.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Each named Schedule IV/VI/VIII botanical/chemical, plant part/origin, current legal listing and target AFB1 versus total aflatoxin.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR aflatoxin entries for nuts, spices, pulses, oilseeds, cereals and foods containing them need named crop and toxin; no single historic-Schedule aflatoxin maximum.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Matrix-matched AFB1 and/or total aflatoxin method on identified extract/processed ingredient, with LOQ/recovery.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: The 'food product containing any of the above' provision may be material to functional premixes, but without authenticated BOM and ingredient proportions one cannot apply it or choose total versus B1.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Complete controlled BOM and percentages, origin/processing of any nuts/spices/oilseeds/cereals, final commercial form and named aflatoxin(s).
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: CTR 'food product containing any of the above' aflatoxin entry may warrant review only once actual constituent articles and final formulation are established; not automatically all premixes.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Aflatoxin B1/total analytical validation for actual composite premix including extraction heterogeneity, LOQ and correct sample basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.product: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
cases.reason_not_approved: Colostrum and colostrum products cannot be treated as the milk row without signed interpretation.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Bovine/buffalo source and colostrum collection stage, concentrate vs mixed supplement, dehydrated form, fat and solids.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Independently signed lead article for actual colostrum product and concentration or reconstitution basis.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: A dairy minerals method that omits lead is insufficient; require validated lead-specific colostrum powder/liquid analysis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: The antibiotic MRPL table expressly discusses honey production; royalty of bee origin does not establish royal jelly is honey. Likewise aquatic and animal tissue veterinary tolerance rows are not automatically royal-jelly standards.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Royal-jelly source and bee production records, formulation/purity and named suspected antibiotic(s).
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Named antibiotic molecule, current legal honey/bee-product or other article and applicable restriction/prohibition provision.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Accredited named-antibiotic method and LOQ for royal jelly's protein/fat/water matrix; no honey-to-royal-jelly transfer.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: FPSFA's silver-leaf identity/quality provisions (including silver purity and animal-origin restrictions) are distinct from a legal lead maximum. A food colour, metal foil or general food CTR row cannot be transferred automatically.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Genuine edible silver foil purity certificate, >99.9% fineness as specified, manufacturing materials, sample weight and supplier lot.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: FSSR silver fineness is a product-quality purity requirement, not an approved CTR lead limit for silver leaf.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Trace lead impurity assessment in high-silver background with lab dilution/blank/recovery, suitable LOQ and precious-metal matrix scope.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Narikela Ksheerika is a described Ayurvedic coconut composite, not authenticated cow/buffalo milk.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Actual labeled Narikela Ksheerika manufacturer recipe, coconut and cow milk proportions, solids/fat, food license.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Signed current Ayurveda Aahara authorization/identity and separate legal lead article for finished marketed sweet.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Finished cooked heterogeneous coconut-dairy matrix lead method, fat check, sampling and LOQ.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Ksheerapaka has a distinct multi-ingredient Ayurvedic identity; ordinary milk rule cannot be assumed.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Actual buffalo milk, aromatic flower species, water, sugar, finished solids/fat and licensed commercial presentation.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Exact authorized Ayurveda Aahara finished-product identity and independently signed lead legal article, not milk analogy.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Validate test for cooked milk/botanical mixture with fat/moisture basis, spikes, LOQ, batch sampling.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.

cases.reason_not_approved: Official FPSFA gives a dextrinification-based fibre identity; this is not automatically digestible dextrin, starch, maltodextrin or a named CTR lead substance.
cases.manufacturer_evidence_required: Dextrin-soluble fibre functional polymer grade, source starch, polymer distribution/DP, ash, glucose content and actual form.
cases.regulatory_legal_decision_required: Fibre classified as dextrin-soluble is not automatically solid glucose or high-ash starch conversion CTR lead article.
cases.method_and_lab_scope_required: Lead test in purified fibre matrix with validated digestion, starch polymer interference and sample-as-sold basis.
cases.external_next_step: Obtain manufacturer specification and authenticated commercial article; legal review of operative original Gazette; accredited named-analyte method and LOQ; representative signed lot CoA; independent QA disposition.
